title: Jubilant Charred Argentinian Meat Skewers
description: Charred and crumbly Argentinian meat skewers featuring seasoned rice vinegar and a sweet glaze, perfect for a festive dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through
While the skewers are cooking, mix the honey with 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl
Brush the honey glaze onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of cooking
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
